# 2.2.1

- Raise the Axios runtime floor from 1.18.1 to 1.19.0 for webhook calls and the HTTPS/Caddy download
  resource. This brings corrected `NO_PROXY` matching, clearer network failures, and Axios's updated
  multipart dependency security floor. Keep the existing public response type of
  `createWebhookClient().status(...)` stable despite Axios adding a new inferred generic parameter.
- Refresh the Node 26 development declarations from 26.1.1 to 26.1.2 and verify the generated
  declarations against the updated toolchain.
